resources.string: Detox uses this service to detect foreground apps for your focus rules. If you separately enable its optional screen guard, it also checks visible Settings text for Detox removal actions. Accessibility data stays on your device.
Shown while a Focus session is running
Android requires this Device Admin to be deactivated before Detox can be uninstalled. This is a deterrent, not an uninstall lock, and it does not give Detox control over your device.
